# Create Jira Custom Charts

The Jira Custom Charts gadget in Dashboard Hub Pro lets you create custom data displays using Jira filters or JQL.

To create a custom chart:

1. Select a predefined filter or enter a custom JQL query.
2. Select a View Type, for example, a pie chart.
3. Customize your visual metaphor by selecting the appropriate aggregations, for example, count, sum, or max.

![Dashboard Hub Jira Custom Charts gadget configuration with JQL filter and chart options](/cms_trial/assets/04fc8f48-1900-4ca3-847b-f9160d9e26f1.png)

To learn more about all the options available, see [Jira Custom Charts](/cms_trial/space/RDD/146309431/Jira+Custom+Charts/).

See live examples of the Jira Custom Chart gadgets [in this dashboard](https://staging-eu.dts-dh.appfire.app/jira/shared/dashboard?), which has been shared with Dashboard Hub's external share feature.
